import: { Button, IconButton, Card, CardAction, TopAppBar, MenuTrigger, Menu, MenuItem, LoadingIndicator }

name: m3e-react: { Icon } only (tree-shaking guard: any other component leaking in fails this)
m3e-react: { Button } only (incl. react-aria press/focus/hover + motion spring)
m3e-react: { LoadingIndicator } only (bundles m3e-shapes + m3e-motion; D13/D14 m3e-shapes budget)
m3e-react: { ExtendedFab } only (incl. react-aria press/focus/hover + motion springs)
m3e-react: { FabMenu } only (incl. react-aria press/focus/hover/outside + motion springs)
m3e-react: { FloatingToolbar } only (incl. FloatingToolbarLayout + RovingFocus from m3e-elements)
m3e-react: { DockedToolbar } only (incl. DockedToolbarLayout + RovingFocus from m3e-elements)
m3e-react: { Menu, MenuItem, MenuSection, MenuTrigger } only (incl. react-aria menu hooks + MenuPopup)
m3e-react: { ButtonGroup, ButtonGroupItem } only (incl. react-aria buttons + menu hooks, ButtonGroupLayout)
m3e-react: { SplitButton, Menu, MenuItem } only (incl. react-aria button + menu hooks, MenuPopup, motion springs)
m3e-react: { LinearProgress } only (the m3e-elements LinearProgressDriver: wavy paths, PathMeasure, progress spring)
m3e-react: { CircularProgress } only (bundles the m3e-shapes Morph for the wavy star)
m3e-react: { SearchBar, SearchResult, AppBarWithSearch } only (incl. SearchLayout + attachTopAppBarScroll from m3e-elements)
m3e-react: { useWindowSizeClass } only (incl. observeWindowSizeClass from m3e-elements)
m3e-react: { ShortNavigationBar } only (incl. react-aria link / button press)
m3e-react: { WideNavigationRail, ModalWideNavigationRail } only (incl. react-aria press + WideNavigationRailLayout from m3e-elements)
m3e-react: { NavigationDrawer } only (incl. react-aria press + NavigationDrawerLayout from m3e-elements)
m3e-react: { Tabs, TabPanel } only (incl. react-aria press + TabsLayout from m3e-elements)
m3exp-web/react: { Icon } only

m3exp-web (root): { Icon } (the root entry registers every custom element by design, ~42.3 kB with <m3e-menu>, <m3e-split-button>, <m3e-button-group>, the toolbars, the progress indicators, <m3e-search>, the navigation bar / rails, <m3e-navigation-drawer>, the window size class observer and <m3e-tabs>; a leaked React component adds ~10 kB of react-aria. Raise with m3e-elements (all); D17)
